model_notes: Reply-bin second boundaries are an explicit mathematical interpretation of the source labels, not verified raw timestamps.
For the timing model only, assume the recorded reply belongs to the same review and precedes its recorded removal strictly: R < T.
Days are modelled as 86400 elapsed seconds; source timestamp resolution and boundary convention are not supplied.
For count intervals only, assume percentages are rounded to the nearest 0.1 percentage point with half-up ties; the publisher rounding rule is unknown.
No-reply rows have no reply-time interval and are not assigned a temporal guarantee.
Counts describe selected deleted reviews, not every posted or reported review.
